subject: Maximum supported R version is 3.2.3 error when published

messages.author: f9c5f1187ca3c5b6
messages.subject: Maximum supported R version is 3.2.3 error when published
parts:
Deploy on local (127.0.0.1) is ok here, but when published, it complains that

Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 166791064 failed: Error parsing manifest:

Maximum supported R version is 3.2.3

Execution halted.

 

I suppose that it is because I am using R version 3.2.4.

Isn’t Shiny deployment should follow the latest version of R?

Does that mean I have to downgrade to R version 3.2.3? how?
